name: Brave
description: Brave Core pins an ECDSA CUP key in its update-client integration; on macOS it integrates Sparkle with automatic checks/retrieves, while the current source describes Omaha 4 as a macOS migration and leaves the claimed Windows path and Sparkle EdDSA enforcement unestablished.
limitations: Newly retrieved Brave Core default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; Sparkle's external framework verifier and platform-specific release packaging were not inspected.
The Brave Core request-sender file embeds the CUP key and includes upstream implementation; this source read does not independently show the delegated proof-verification routine.
